ra.text: Learning a new language takes time, but small daily steps help a lot. Reading a short article, listening to a podcast or writing a few sentences every day can make a real difference after a few months.

ra.text: The museum is open from nine in the morning until six in the evening. Entry is free for students on the first Sunday of each month. Visitors can also join a guided tour in English at eleven.

ra.text: Sleep is important for memory. While we sleep, the brain sorts the information of the day and keeps what it needs. Students who sleep well before an exam often remember more than those who study all night.

asq.question: What do you call the room where people sleep?
asq.tr: İnsanların uyuduğu odaya ne denir? Yatak odası.

asq.question: How many days are there in a week?
asq.tr: Bir haftada kaç gün vardır? Yedi.

asq.question: Which season comes after winter?
asq.tr: Kıştan sonra hangi mevsim gelir? İlkbahar.

asq.question: What is the name of the person who flies a plane?
